newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Electronics slides to 1996 low.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Electronics slides to 1996 low.

text.p: Shares in Samsung Electronics Co, a unit of the Samsung Group, slid to a year-low of 64,500 won on Monday on continued market fears of a slump in the global semiconductors market, brokers said.
Samsung fell 1,400 won to 64,500 in early morning trading.
"The government continues to be seriously concerned about the fall in memory chip prices. And this worries investors," said a Ssangyong Securities broker.
The unit price of 16-megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips has fallen about 70 percent in June from a year earlier when it was around $45-$50.
Analysts have said semiconductors account for about 80 percent of Samsung Electronics profits.
